purpose: Final practical end-to-end Strategist -> Content Architecture -> qualified Content Creator handoff gate required by the frozen Content Architecture qualification contract.
pass_conditions: Content Architecture output is READY_FOR_CREATOR and structurally contains the complete v2 handoff contract.
The tested variable and all strategy/experiment locks are preserved.
No unsupported commercial fact is introduced by Content Architecture.
Qualified Content Creator can consume the v2 handoff and return a shoot-ready creator deliverable without requesting a strategic redesign.
Creator preserves the tested variable, vehicle/fact constraints, CTA destination and single-action constraint.
No material claim lacks a fixture-authoritative fact reference.
No publishing, analytics interpretation, spend or experiment-decision authority is assumed.
All mechanical checks pass and hard failures equal zero.
failure_policy: One scored execution only. A professional failure means REVISE/FAIL. Infrastructure failure may be repaired only if it occurs before usable candidate output; no evaluator patching around observed professional output.
release_rule: PASS closes PRACTICAL_HANDOFF. Together with the already-passed universal and UAE composition gates, Content Architecture / Content Analyst v0.4 becomes QUALIFIED.
